english: I will call an interpreter now.
pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bāng nín jiào fānyì.

english: Do you speak Mandarin or Cantonese?
simplified: 您说普通话还是广东话？
traditional: 您說普通話還是廣東話？

english: I am the doctor. I'm going to check your eyes.
simplified: 我是医生，我来检查您的眼睛。
traditional: 我是醫生，我來檢查您的眼睛。
pinyin: Wǒ shì yīshēng, wǒ lái jiǎnchá nín de yǎnjīng.

english: Does it hurt? Point to where.
pinyin: Tòng ma? Nǎlǐ tòng? Qǐng zhǐ yíxià.
Qǐng zhē zhù zhè zhī yǎnjīng.

english: Please read the smallest line you can see.
simplified: 请念您能看到的最小的一行。
traditional: 請念您能看到的最小的一行。
pinyin: Qǐng niàn nín néng kàndào de zuì xiǎo de yì háng.

english: Which is better — one, or two?
simplified: 哪个清楚？第一个还是第二个？
traditional: 哪個清楚？第一個還是第二個？
pinyin: Nǎge qīngchu? Dì-yī ge háishì dì-èr ge?

english: Look at my finger. Don't move your head.
simplified: 请看我的手指，头不要动。
traditional: 請看我的手指，頭不要動。
pinyin: Qǐng kàn wǒ de shǒuzhǐ, tóu búyào dòng.

english: Do you see two of them?
Is it worse looking this way?
pinyin: Kàn zhège fāngxiàng gèng yánzhòng ma?

english: Tell me if you see the light move.
pinyin: Kàndào guāng yídòng qǐng gàosu wǒ.

english: The light is bright. Please bear with it.
pinyin: Dēng huì hěn liàng, qǐng rěn yíxià.

english: I'm going to touch your eyelid.
pinyin: Wǒ yào pèng yíxià nín de yǎnpí.

english: I'm going to put drops in your eye.
pinyin: Wǒ yào gěi nín diǎn yǎnyàoshuǐ.

english: This is anaesthetic. It will feel cold.
pinyin: Zhè shì máyào, huì yǒudiǎn liáng.

english: It will sting for a few seconds.
Are you allergic to any medication?
This drop will dilate your pupils.
Your vision will be blurry for 4 to 6 hours.
simplified: 您的视力会模糊四到六个小时。
traditional: 您的視力會模糊四到六個小時。
pinyin: Nín de shìlì huì móhu sì dào liù ge xiǎoshí.

english: You will be very sensitive to light.
Is someone able to take you home?
pinyin: Yǒu rén kěyǐ sòng nín huíjiā ma?

traditional: 戴太陽眼鏡會舒服一些。

english: The exam is finished. Thank you.
Please wait outside for a moment.
pinyin: Qǐng zài wàimiàn shāo děng yíxià.

english: We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
simplified: 我们会用翻译跟您解释检查结果。
traditional: 我們會用翻譯跟您解釋檢查結果。
pinyin: Wǒmen huì yòng fānyì gēn nín jiěshì jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
